text_block_list.text: While walking through the academy grounds, I heard an overly theatrical voice coming from behind the school building. Peeking around the corner—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: O, my heart! May my feelings reach Dog-san and Rabbit-san!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Eh, ah... T-They're reaching me! They're totally reaching me!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
............
There's no dialogue like that in the script.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah-hahaha! We are slated to perform a short play for the children at an upcoming event!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: In order to impart an indelible splash of color upon the shining stars of the future, I am advancing preparations alongside Top Road-san and Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I choked up on my lines just now, too...! I still have to practice way harder...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...That was only because Opera O threw in an ad-lib.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: There is no cause for concern! The success of our performance is already preordained!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: For I simply stand upon the stage... and by that alone, an eternal light illuminates everyone's hearts... That is the very destiny I shoulder, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Mmm... such overwhelming confidence as always...! Alright! I'll follow her lead and try ad-libbing too—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Wai—...! Everything will spin completely out of hand...!
...And so, observing their rehearsal left me feeling somewhat uneasy... but when the day of the event arrived—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —Behold, Dog-san and Rabbit-san! Yonder lies the utopia we have sought!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Over seas, over mountains, over valleys...! We've finally reached it, woof...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I-I'm exhausted... pyon. It was a long, long journey............ pyon.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Keep it up~! You're almost there~!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Now then, you two! Do you still have
the strength to flap your wings and fly, I wonder!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Only a little further to our destination!
Who shall carve the very first step?!
Let us finish this with a race!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah?! I-I won't lose, woof!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I... I'm going too, pyon!

The three performers leaped off the stage, engaging in a heated race around the audience for the climax...
The children were absolutely thrilled!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Phew... How was it?!
Our performance!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Actually, you know... That whole part where we started running at the climax was completely ad-libbed!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
But it turned out to be a great finale, didn't it?
Opera O-chan really is incredible!

That was certainly true. Still...
Between this and how she handled those delinquents before, where does that unshakeable mentality come from?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
She threw in endless ad-libs besides the climax, too...
Yet she never strayed from the main storyline.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Honestly, I doubt anyone could pull that off without having thoroughly studied the script beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Hmm... That's true...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —Hwahaha! How was it, you two?! Just as I declared before, it turned out to be a magnificent performance, did it not?!
choice_data_list: You're a massive hit with the kids.
You became super popular with the kids.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —Hwahaha! How was it, you two?! Just as I declared before, it turned out to be a magnificent performance, did it not?!
choice_data_list: You're a massive hit with the kids.
You became super popular with the kids.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Precisely! Now then, shall we go give our stage greetings to our little fans!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah~! Mr. Doggie~! Miss Bunny~!
Opera O~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Yes, yes!
Mr. Doggie is on her way~!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...It might be a bit late to ask, but why were the two of us playing animals, while Opera O was just... normally Opera O...?
TM Opera O and the others spent some lively, cheerful time giving fan service to the excited children.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A professional, you say? Hahaha!
I cannot be contained within such narrow bounds!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Opera O does not merely act as Opera O! Standing, sitting, or walking, I am ever Opera O! How could I do anything less than captivate the entire world!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...If you compliment her normally, she'll never stop, so please hold back.
In any case, TM Opera O and the others had put on a thoroughly sensational show.
